scientific_comparison.primary: 24 paired native train.stress comparisons =6tasks ×2grouping schemes ×2modelseeds; task-native metric, no aggregate heterogeneous metric.
scientific_comparison.secondary: Best stop rank and subsequent official Valid rank from specified scorer; Valid never trains/stops/selects this batch.
scientific_comparison.decision_before_results: For each task, both seeds positive in both eligible schemes supports group-stress robustness of the full recipe; a scheme with two negative pairs is a split-dependent reversal; mixed seeds remain uncertain. Record magnitudes and all cells. A result in DILI can falsify the expected non-transfer pattern. Ineligible scheme is missing evidence, never a win.
scientific_comparison.limits: Retrospective reuse of historically seen officialtrain; not pristine holdout or independentdataset. Canonical/scaffold alter membership and effective fit size; comparison between schemes is descriptive. Representation+scaling+dimension+headcapacity stay bundled. Model seeds are replicates on the same split, not independent datasets.
scientific_comparison.same_device: Allpaired recipes within task/scheme/seed must run same GPU UUID and exact H140 head environment; preferred allbatch GPU2 if safe. Executor may choose another Hainan GPU before first fit; record and hold perpair. No mixing hosts.

partition_rule.binding: Generate and freeze12records under operator/partitions and corresponding bound-configs; attach original train file hash, actualRDKit version and identical row indices across representations/seeds. This deterministic data binding is authorized, no science/config search.
partition_rule.eligibility: Existing check_eligibility:fit>=50%N;stop>=20;stress>=20;bothclasses each classificationpartition;nonconstant regression each. Ineligible task/scheme skips all4fits; no redrawnseed/relaxedthreshold/alternatefraction.
partition_rule.compatibility: Existing documented sequential-sum diagnostic compatibility allowed if needed; membership and eligibility unchanged, retain original.
partition_rule.reuse_existing_records: Exact existing D20 DILI/Sol records may be reused if input, RDKit grouping,method and hashes match. This reuses split only; D20 modelseed47 is different from new44/45.
